name: leadership-bios
title: Leadership bios
description: Large portraits and full bios for founders, partners or a board: one person per row, with earlier roles and links.
docs: Pass two to six members. A portrait is drawn at 4:5 and cropped from the centre; leave photo out and a monogram keeps the row's height; it also stays behind a photo that fails to load, so use opaque images. alternate puts the portrait on the right of every second row from 768px up, and a phone always shows it first. Set external on links to other sites, and pass linkAs={Link} for internal ones. Words come from labels.
